features.name: Onboarding framework
features.description: A framework designed for Business Central that caters to both exploratory users and those needing guided handholding, providing relevant in-context guidance without blocking user paths.

features.name: Scalable partner onboarding
features.description: Capability for partners to scale onboarding experiences to more customers while ensuring relevant onboarding content tailored to specific customer business needs.
